architecture.codeword_storage: one canonical little-endian FP16 32768x8 output-space table
architecture.condition: none; one literal table is shared by all roles, layers, and experts
architecture.name: DOCB-WE-S0-v0
architecture.training: deterministic stratified initialization, 1024 minibatch Lloyd updates, checkpoint empty/stale-cluster repair, then one complete Lloyd refinement pass

claim_boundary: A kill rejects only this frozen direct-output K=32768,d=8 K-means cell on the authenticated six-expert split. A promotion is an ideal-Gaussian-residual feasibility result on two held-out experts, not a finite residual codec, model-wide generalization, fresh-validation result, or target achievement.

execution.whole_holdout_evaluation: exact nearest canonical-FP16 codeword for every vector in all six holdout matrices

gaussian_control.matching: each synthetic natural row is independently standardized and affinely mapped to the corresponding source row mean and RMS
gaussian_control.training_and_evaluation: same split, initialization, updates, checkpoints, empty-cluster policy, exact search, FP16 serialization, and rate ledger as source

oracle.definition: canonical FP16 direct table with exact output-space assignment followed by an ideal continuous Gaussian residual code using every residual bit
oracle.hard_kill: KILL if both predeclared source seeds have pooled F>0.8; an early collapse is recorded separately but does not replace exact held-out oracle scoring
oracle.promote: PROMOTE only if both source seeds have pooled s>=0.18096404744368115, every held-out expert has F<=0.8 in both seeds, both matched advantages are positive, and neither source seed tripped a collapse checkpoint
oracle.scope: only the exact direct-output K-means training cell; not a converse for arbitrary vector quantizers or nonlinear codecs

panel.source_payload_resolution: each output_relpath is resolved beneath the authenticated lock parent blind_protocol_v2/unblinded
